attempts.verdict: host memory exhaustion at the post-load stage. GB10's ~120 GiB is unified (host and device share one pool), so --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 reserves against a budget the host runtime also draws on — which is not the case on the discrete B200/B300 NVIDIA tested. 0.70-0.75 is the first thing to change on the next attempt.
